themeMode.label: Active theme palette
themeMode.description: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting as it changes.

invertVerticalCoordinate.label: Invert vertical coordinate
invertVerticalCoordinate.description: Flip the battlefield rows top to bottom, so lands sit at the top of your side.

minPlayersForMultiColumnLayout.label: Minimum player count for multi-column layout

horizontalHand.label: Display hand horizontally (wastes space)
horizontalHand.description: Off, your hand is a column beside your life and zones, and every card in it stays in view.

leftJustifiedHand.label: Enable left justification
leftJustifiedHand.description: Starts a horizontal hand at the left instead of centring it.

displayCardNames.label: Display card names on cards having a picture
displayCardNames.description: A face-down card, and a card whose picture cannot be loaded, always shows its name.

autoRotateSidewaysLayoutCards.label: Auto-Rotate cards with sideways layout
autoRotateSidewaysLayoutCards.description: Battles, split cards and planes are turned sideways in the card preview so they read upright.

maxFontSizeForCards.label: Maximum font size for information displayed on cards

verticalCardOverlapPercent.label: Minimum overlap percentage of cards on the stack and in vertical hand

cardViewInitialRowsMax.label: Maximum initial height for card view window

cardViewExpandedRowsMax.label: Maximum expanded height for card view window
cardViewExpandedRowsMax.description: Double-click a card view's title bar to switch between its initial and expanded heights. A size you set by dragging its corner is kept instead.

showShortcutsInMenus.label: Show keyboard shortcuts in right-click menus

bumpSetsWithCardsInDeckToTop.label: Bump sets that the deck contains cards from to the top in the printing selector
